newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed ahead of budget.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed ahead of budget.

text.p: Dhaka stocks are likely to be mixed on Wednesday, and brokers said the trend might continue until the new budget was announced.

"The market is in the grip of a typical pre-budget uncertainty. A mixed trend will continue until the new budget is unfolded," said broker Khurshid Alam. The 1997-98 budget (July-June) is due to be presented on June 12. The DSE all-share price index dropped 5.9 points or 0.49 percent at 1,173.5 on turnover of 66.1 million taka on Tuesday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-50636
